intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in San Bernardino for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events. The magic runs from December 1 (library Christmas crafts) through December 23 (the gingerbread house craft at Inghram Branch Library), with the Tree Lighting Ceremony at City Hall (December 3), Miracle on Court Street (December 9 to 20) and a Santa breakfast (December 19) along the way, plus the Lake Arrowhead Classical Ballet Nutcracker (December 4 to 6). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in San Bernardino

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in San Bernardino
  • Lights and skating: Miracle on Court Street at Court Street Square Park, nightly December 9 to 20
  • Tree lighting: the Tree Lighting Ceremony at San Bernardino City Hall (December 3)
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus at the library, Santa visits to the branch libraries and a Saturday Santa breakfast (December 19)
  • Library crafts: Christmas crafts at the Villasenor, Rowe and Inghram branches, plus the Inghram holiday crafts (December 2 and 9)
  • Stage: The Nutcracker by the Lake Arrowhead Classical Ballet Company at the San Manuel Performing Arts Center (December 4 to 6)
  • Season: December 1 to December 23

Planning a bigger day out? San Bernardino families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens, Santa visits and holiday lights nearby.
